It also operates the pharmacy chains Vitusapotek and the franchise chain Ditt Apotek. NMD is part of the McKesson Corporation and has approximately 300 pharmacies in Norway. The company is based in Oslo." [wikipedia] Business address: Alf Bjerckes vei 28, 0582 OSLO. [brreg_enheter] Leadership: general manager (daglig leder) Rune Spikseth; board chair Runar Hollevik; 7 other board members. [brreg_roller] Owner / parent organisation (Wikidata): McKesson Corporation. [wikidata]

- Registered employees: 3,777 (as of 2026-09-10); 297 registered sub-units. [brreg_enheter]
